summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the master's 99926000 subscribes as NSE|26000, and the index tk snapshot with AliceBlue's change (cv) and percent (pc) becomes an index Quote frame.

notes: An index token loses its 999 prefix on both (aliceblue_adapter.py:575-579; brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs feed_token).
The desktop takes AliceBlue's own change and percent for the index (cv, pc) over its own derivation (brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs on_data).

deviations.reason: The desktop's data carries the symbol, exchange, mode label and receipt timestamp in every frame, as every broker's do on the desktop and the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry them (docs/api/websocket-streaming/ltp.md shows timestamp); this web adapter's dict has none of them (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305).

The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt, a string of epoch seconds ("1794302700"); feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds as numbers (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.
AliceBlue's index tick carries its change (cv); the web's mapper reads it as change_value and never publishes it (aliceblue_adapter.py:1259-1268). The desktop sends it as price_change.
The desktop sends the canonical price_change_percent beside the web's change_percent (feed::dialect aliases, WS-05); the web sends change_percent only.

The web's Quote sends average_price 0.0 for an index tick that carries none (parsed_data.get("average_price", 0.0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).
The web's Quote sends total_oi 0 for an index tick that carries no toi; a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0.
